name: Crown of Lust
source:
Crown of Lust is a fantasy adult visual novel that throws you into the diplomatic deep end as Prince Aldric, a sheltered royal sent to as an envoy of peace into the fearsome Kingdom of Valoria—a land your kingdom has been at war with for generations.

Raised on terrifying tales of Valorian savagery, you arrive at their borders expecting the worst...only to discover that the "barbarians" are a kingdom of beautiful women who find your royal mannerisms equally as strange as you find their customs.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3585690/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《欲望王冠》是一部奇幻成人视觉小说，让你扮演阿尔德里克王子，一位受庇护的皇室成员，被派往可怕的瓦洛里亚王国作为和平使者，进入外交深渊——你的王国已经与这片土地交战了几代人。

你在勇敢的野蛮人的恐怖故事中长大，到达他们的边境时，你已经做好了最坏的打算……却发现“野蛮人”是一个美丽女人的王国，他们发现你的皇室举止和你发现他们的习俗一样奇怪。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3585690/]Steam[/url]]
